entities.name: Eidren
entities.description: A Lorwyn elf of the Gilt-Leaf tribe, a Perfect who became taercenn; in Shadowmoor a Wilt-Leaf First Vigilant.

entities.name: Peradala
entities.description: Perfect of the Mornsong tribe whom Eidren planned to marry.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Only survivor of the attacked wedding convoy.

entities.name: Nath
entities.description: Gilt-Leaf taercenn whose mantle Eidren took on after his death.

entities.name: Gryffid
entities.description: Gilt-Leaf daen, a hunter, reluctant to take Eidren's orders.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Captured by Gryffid and offered a deal by Eidren.

entities.name: Brion
entities.description: Came to Rhys' help and died.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: Event that struck as Rhys accepted the offer.

events.summary: The wedding convoy bringing Peradala was attacked by fae and everybody killed except Maralen.
events.quote: the wedding convoy that should have brought Peradala to Lys Alana was attacked by fae for unknown reasons, and everybody was killed, save for Maralen

events.summary: Eidren became Gilt-Leaf taercenn after Nath's death.
events.quote: Eidren took up the mantle of Gilt-Leaf taercenn after Nath 's death.

events.summary: Eidren revealed he had enchanted himself with nettlevines, shortening his life to under two years.
events.quote: shortening his expected lifespan to less than two more years

events.summary: Eidren stopped Gryffid from killing the captured Rhys and offered him a deal.
events.quote: Eidren stopped his hand and gave him an order to let Rhys be.

events.summary: Brion killed most of the elves but died when Eidren threw moonglove extract at his throat.
events.quote: Brion eliminated most of the elves but died when Eidren threw a vial of moonglove extract at his throat.

events.summary: Rhys accepted Eidren's offer moments before the Great Aurora struck.
events.quote: Rhys accepted Eidren's offer, just mere moments before the Great Aurora struck.

events.summary: In Shadowmoor, Eidren used his body as a conduit of forest magic to hurl Ashling away from Mistmeadow, destroying himself.
events.quote: the flux of magic force destroyed Eidren's body in the process

relations.quote: Eidren was planning to marry Peradala
Eidren was a Lorwyn elf of the Gilt-Leaf tribe.
Brion eliminated most of the elves but died when Eidren threw a vial of moonglove extract at his throat.
